lines.text: The Bog of Eternal Deductions. The air smells of moss and unpaid balances.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Bad news, hero. The Taxlord has audited the ENTIRE kingdom. Even the birds owe back taxes on their nests.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: You have loot. Loot is income. Oh dear — here comes a frog with a briefcase. RUN. No wait, FIGHT. Fight is deductible.
A throne of filing cabinets rises from the murk. Upon it: an ancient horror in a sensible cardigan.

lines.speaker: The Taxlord
lines.text: AH. THE DELINQUENT. YOUR EXTENSION REQUEST WAS RECEIVED. IT WAS BEAUTIFUL. IT IS DENIED.

lines.speaker: The Taxlord
lines.text: RECEIPTS?! No one... in nine hundred years... has brought receipts. VERY WELL. WE PROCEED TO ARBITRATION. ARBITRATION IS COMBAT.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: WE DID IT! The kingdom's taxes are settled for the year!
